resources.string: Graphics switching is not available. This is expected in the virtual machine and on a system image without the NVIDIA graphics package.
You have not installed any apps yet.
The per-app choices could not be read. Open this page again to retry.
These apps may use the NVIDIA compute service. Enter a package name to add one.

If the computer does not start properly with the NVIDIA GPU: in the boot menu press e, add gb.nouveau=0 at the end of the line and press Enter. The NVIDIA GPU then stays off for that start. Choose Intel only above to keep it off.
